application: Delegation register (delegation tool): type, schema, evaluator, score, automation leads.
preuve: Instruction. | v3: investigation of the recurrences of 16 Oct 2026 (PLAN_recidives_outils_v2.md).
regle: Every sub-delegated task has a typed output (schema) and a deterministic evaluation script with hard rules; the automatable steps of the task type are noted and automated over the course of use, without a reasoning LLM — reusing first: the tool that already covers the step (tool catalogue, chercher_outil, project scripts), otherwise a new version of the closest tool, and only as a last resort a new tool, with `CATALOGUE CONSULTÉ` ("CATALOGUE CONSULTED") at the top (v3, 16 Oct 2026: the phrase "becomes a tool" pushed people to create without searching; tools recreated: verifier_noms, porte_livraison).
titre: Every delegation has its deterministic evaluator
